clips.title: The story
paras: Burning Blade cultists gather at Skull Rock, hidden in Durotar's eastern coastal cliffs. Their cavern lies east of Orgrimmar, where they plot against Thrall's Horde.

Burning Blade cultists gather in Skull Rock, a perilous stronghold beneath northeastern Durotar's crags. Dark cultists, fel-worshipping orcs, and summoners meet in its winding tunnels to practice demonic arts and plot against the young Horde. The warlock Gazz'uz leads the cell. Its work threatens Orgrimmar's nearby gates and travelers along the eastern shore.
